name: @ichava/icon-browser
description: Inertia + React adapter for the Ichava icon browser (Laravel). The browser UI is the vendored @ichava/react-icon-browser library.

scripts.// clean: Narrow on purpose. inertia-app.js/.css are CHECKED IN and no npm script or CI job rebuilds them -- only build does. rm -rf public/* destroyed them, and a failing vite build destroyed them for nothing. Delete only what the build re-emits. See issue #26.
scripts.build: npm run clean && echo '' && echo '🔨 Building Ichava (dev)...' && NODE_ENV=development vite build --config vite.inertia.config.ts
scripts.build:prod: npm run clean && echo '' && echo '🚀 Building Ichava (production)...' && NODE_ENV=production vite build --config vite.inertia.config.ts
scripts.watch: echo '' && echo '👀 Watching Ichava for changes...' && vite build --watch --config vite.inertia.config.ts
